raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "7.7.0"
  build_number: 6
  # dependencies
  swig_version: 4.4.1

recipe:
  name: lal-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://software.igwn.org/sources/source/lalsuite/lal-${{ version }}.tar.xz
    sha256: 37a6abda137ea8319bff4d5f3018adc79bb0a007344f8bd512a14192ccfde12b
    patches:
      # to update the patches for a new release:
      #
      #     # -- checkout the new source release tag
      #     cd /path/to/git/lalsuite
      #     git fetch
      #     git checkout <release-tag>
      #     # -- apply the patches on top of the release tag
      #     git am --3way /path/to/git/lal-feedstock/recipe/patches/*.patch
      #     <resolve-any-conflicts>
      #     # -- render new patch files
      #     git format-patch <release-tag> lal/ -o lal-patches
      #     # -- copy them back to the feedstock
      #     cd /path/to/git/lal-feedstock
      #     git rm recipe/patches/*.patch
      #     cp /path/to/git/lalsuite/lal-patches/*.patch recipe/patches/
      #     git add recipe/patches/*.patch
      #     <update-this-file-as-required>

      # see https://git.ligo.org/lscsoft/lalsuite/-/issues/300
      - if: linux
        then:
          - patches/0001-lal-use-RTLD_DEEPBIND-when-importing-the-LAL-SWIG-li.patch
      # backport https://git.ligo.org/lscsoft/lalsuite/-/merge_requests/2529
      - patches/0002-lal-swig-SWIGPython.i-use-import_array1-0-to-import-.patch
      - patches/0003-lal-swig-SWIGPython.i-SwigPyObject_type-was-renamed-.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number | int + 100 if fft_impl == "fftw" else build_number }}
  skip:
    - win

outputs:

  # -- Staging -----------------------

  - staging:
      name: lal-c-build
    build:
      script: build.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - bc
        - diffutils
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        # needed by ./configure, the version constraint prevents python
        # being treated as a variant key for the staging output
        - python >=3.6
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
      host:
        - gsl
        - hdf5
        - zlib
        - if: fft_impl == "fftw"
          then: fftw
        - if: fft_impl == "mkl"
          then: mkl-devel

  # -- Packages ----------------------

  - package:
      name: liblal
    inherit: lal-c-build
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - include/lal/
        - lib/liblal*
        - lib/pkgconfig/lal*.pc
      string: ${{ fft_impl }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblal", upper_bound="x") }}
      run_constraints:
        # building against lal-swig requires the same version of swig
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
        # 7.1.1 is the version where the packages were restructured
        - lal >=7.1.1
        - python-lal >=7.1.1
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - lal/LALConfig.h
            - lal/SWIGCommon.i
          lib:
            - lal
            - lalsupport
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
        script:
          - pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version "${PKG_VERSION}" lal
          - pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version "${PKG_VERSION}" lalsupport
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Library shared object libraries
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the shared-object libraries needed to run
        applications that use the LAL library.

  - package:
      name: python-lal
    inherit:
      from: lal-c-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - lib/python*/site-packages/
      script: build-python.sh
      string: ${{ fft_impl }}_py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      variant:
        # use the same keys as liblal so that we ensure a unique
        # python-lal build string for each unique liblal build
        use_keys:
          - gsl
          - hdf5
          - zlib
          - if: fft_impl == "fftw"
            then: fftw
          - if: fft_impl == "mkl"
            then: mkl

    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - python
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblal", exact=True) }}
        - numpy
        - python
        # needed by ./configure
        - if: fft_impl == "mkl"
          then: mkl-include
        - zlib
        # needed by the test suite
        - if: build_platform == target_platform
          then:
            - pytest
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblal", exact=True) }}
        - igwn-segments
        - python
        - python-dateutil
        - scipy
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          # needed by ./configure but not linked by python-lal
          - libzlib
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - lal
            - lal.utils
          pip_check: false
      - requirements:
          run:
            - freezegun
            - lscsoft-glue
            - pytest >=4.0
        files:
          source:
            - test/python/
        script:
          # run the test suite, but exclude tests that depend on igwn-ligolw
          - "export PYTEST_ADDOPTS=\"--ignore test/python/test_rate.py --ignore test/python/test_series.py -k 'not lal.rate and not lal.series'\""
          - python -m pytest -ra -v test/python
          # test regression for https://git.ligo.org/lscsoft/lalsuite/-/issues/478
          - python -c "import numpy; import lal; print(lal.CreateForwardREAL8FFTPlan(512, 1))"
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Library Python bindings
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
        This package contains the Python bindings of the LAL C libraries
        and additional Python modules.

        Note: this package only provides the importable Python libraries.
        All command-line interfaces, scripts, and executables are
        part of the `lal` package.

  - package:
      name: lal
    inherit:
      from: lal-c-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      dynamic_linking:
        overdepending_behavior: error
      files:
        - bin/
        - etc/lal-user-env.*
        - share/man/
      script: install-bin.sh
      string: ${{ fft_impl }}_py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      variant:
        # use the same keys as liblal so that we ensure a unique
        # lal build string for each unique liblal build
        use_keys:
          - gsl
          - hdf5
          - zlib
          - if: fft_impl == "fftw"
            then: fftw
          - if: fft_impl == "mkl"
            then: mkl

    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - help2man >=1.37
        - make
        - pkg-config >=0.18.0
        - rsync
        - sed
        - swig ${{ swig_version }}.*
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - numpy
            - python
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblal", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("python-lal", exact=True) }}
        - igwn-segments
        - numpy
        - python
        # needed by ./configure
        - if: fft_impl == "fftw"
          then: fftw
        - if: fft_impl == "mkl"
          then: mkl-include
        - zlib
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("liblal", exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("python-lal", exact=True) }}
        - igwn-segments
        - numpy
        - python
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          # needed by ./configure but not linked by lal
          - libzlib
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: fft_impl == "fftw"
            then:
              - lal_fftw_wisdom --help
              - lal_fftwf_wisdom --help
          - lal_path2cache <<< A-B-0-1.gwf
          - lal_simd_detect
          - lal_version --verbose
          - test "$(lal_tconvert --rfc-2822 800000000)" == "Fri, 13 May 2005 06:13:07 +0000"
          - test "$(lal_tconvert Fri, 13 May 2005 06:13:07 +0000)" -eq 800000000
          - test "$(lal_tconvert 1831518865)" == "Tue Jan 19 03:14:07 UTC 2038"
          - test "$(lal_tconvert 1831518866)" == "Tue Jan 19 03:14:08 UTC 2038"
    about:
      summary: LSC Algorithm Library
      description: |
        The LSC Algorithm Library for gravitational wave data analysis.

about:
  summary: LSC Algorithm Library
  description: |
    The LSC Algorithm Library for gravitational wave data analysis.
    This package contains the shared-object libraries needed to run
    applications that use the LAL library.  If you want to install
    the Python bindings, please install the associated python-lal
    package.
  homepage: https://wiki.ligo.org/Computing/LALSuite
  documentation: https://lscsoft.docs.ligo.org/lalsuite/lal/
  repository: https://git.ligo.org/lscsoft/lalsuite/
  license: GPL-2.0-or-later
  license_file: COPYING

  recipe-maintainers:
    - duncanmmacleod
    - skymoo
